extraction.Name: George Colhoff
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat. Recorded Jun. 18, 1923, by Security Savings Bank
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged SW± 26-37-39 (including the NW1) to State Bank of Scenic, Scenic, So. Dak. for $2000.00; SW4 26-37-39 deeded to Enla B. Snodgrass of Interior, So. Dak. by George Colhoff and Louisa Colhoff, his wife, on Aug. 18, 1925 for $1.00 and other valuable considerations
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jan. 15, 1920. Mortgage recorded Jan. 25, 1923. Deed to Enla B. Snodgrass recorded Aug. 19, 1925. Wife named Louisa Colhoff (also spelled Louise Colhoff). Land described as SW4 26-37-39. Document taken from records at the County Seat.
